blocks.text: 104 19232 Enterprise Way Cloverdale BC Surrey V3S 6J9

parts.t: For lease: 3,585 sq. ft. strata office/warehouse unit at 104-19232 Enterprise Way, Surrey, featuring 2,494 sq. ft. on the main floor plus a 1, 091 sq. ft. mezzanine for flexible warehouse and office use. Includes a grade-level 12' x 14' 6 overhead loading door, open production/storage area, mezzanine workspace, and bathroom. CD/IL zoning supports a wide range of uses including light impact industry, warehouse, distribution, transportation industry, vehicle/RV storage, industrial equipment rentals, self-storage warehouse, and contractor/engineering/utility office uses. Convenient access to major routes including Hwy 10. Ideal for a variety of businesses.
